body: Test written, module exists, 3 real contract disagreements. (1) rest_recovery at 300s/cond50 returns enough to reach MAX_STAMINA - contract says never rests back to full. (2) Same at cond100 - also reaches MAX. (3) Fight simulation (cond50, ~475 strikes, movement at 20Hz, 3x5min rounds, 2 rests) ends at stamina 1.0 - contract says 25..75 band. Movement drain alone across 18000 ticks empties the tank. All 7 other assertion groups pass (positivity, ordering, conditioning direction, apply clamping, NaN/INF sweep, unrecognised intents, fatigue_fraction, determinism). Test file ready at Godot/tests/fight_stamina_test.gd but NOT committed - would make suite red. You reconcile.
